Report printing

docs / specs / print.spec.html

QA fixture: an older spec whose criteria name no story.

User stories

As a manager, I print the report and hand it out at the weekly meeting.

As a manager, I print a range of weeks at once.

Acceptance criteria

The Print button prints the report page exactly as shown.

Printing a range of weeks prints one page per week; the report's onboarding section gains a Printing step.
